title: Closing Window
summary: Pick up my runner at the canal, then shake an armed response. You have 150 seconds from pickup to get them home. Plan your escape before you start.

car.text: Get a car. Mara's is outside the safehouse.

pickup.text: Drive to {place} ({distance} m), stop in the bay and press K to collect the runner.

escape.text: Lose the police. Break line of sight and stay hidden.

deliver.text: Get the runner to {place} ({distance} m). Stop in the bay and press K.
